answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14485 Country: India Title: Assalamu Alaikum W R: 1. Please reply - If we are travelling either in Jamat (dawah) or personally can we pray namaaz by making jamath (for namaaz) befor regular Jamath (for Namaz) in Masjid. 2. Is it sunnath to leave sunnath namaaz (both Sunnath-e-Moakadah & Ghair Moakadah) while we are traveling-please provide me the detailed information for the same. Jazakallahu Khair Question: Assalamu Alaikum W R: 1. Please reply - If we are travelling either in Jamat (dawah) or personally can we pray namaaz by making jamath (for namaaz) befor regular Jamath (for Namaz) in Masjid. 2. Is it sunnath to leave sunnath namaaz (both Sunnath-e-Moakadah & Ghair Moakadah) while we are traveling-please provide me the detailed information for the same. Jazakallahu Khair Answer ID: 14485 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1239/1239=M/1430) (1) It is allowable, but one should not make it habit. If such situation arises one can perform salah at home or a place outside mosque. However, it is better to wait for the jama?ah if there is no so much hurry: وف ي الشامي: یکرہ تکرار الجماعۃ في مسجد محلۃ بأذان وإقامۃ إلا إذا صلی بھما فیہ أولا غیر أھلہ أو أھلہ لکن بمخافتۃ الأذان الخ (2) If a traveller is in comfort not in hurry, it is better to perform all sunnah salah with fardh. But, if he is not comfortable and is in hurry, he can leave the sunnah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
